manifest.request_verbatim:
Design a model rocket plane (boost-glide airframe) with an integrated central flight computer: MCU (STM32F4-class) + 3V3 buck, MPU6050 IMU, BMP280 baro, LIS3MDL mag, NEO-6M GPS. Full multi-domain mission:
1) PLAN the system (airframe + avionics architecture, interfaces, budgets).
2) PART SOURCING — resolve every IC/connector/fastener via the parts library and/or ecad_find_part; record BOM with provenance.
3) SCHEMATIC — ecad_new_schematic / place / WIRE nets (ecad_connect / net tools) so the netlist has simulatable devices before SPICE.
4) SPICE — ecad_simulate OP on the wired 3V3 front-end; measure V(3V3).
5) PCB LAYOUT + TRACE OPT — REQUIRED chain: board_from_schematic → ecad_optimize_traces → ecad_run_drc (errors==0 or honest FAIL).
6) ANTENNA/RF — ecad_antenna_design + analyze for 2.4 GHz IFA and GPS patch; use openEMS path when provisioned, else document honest degrade/SKIP.
7) FIRMWARE — fw_new_project(stm32f4) + pinmap from netlist + fw_build.
8) RENODE SENSOR-IN-THE-LOOP — climb_turn_profile → fw_sensor_scenario → fw_sim_run + fw_verify_board; SKIP honestly if Renode absent.
9) MECHANICAL — model the rocket-plane airframe as editable CAD with verify_battery PASS: body tube ~OD 40–60mm length ≥300mm, 3–4 fins, wing/glide surface, closed payload bay volume ≥ board envelope; use sketch+extrude/revolve + fillets; avoid zero-thickness and open shells.
10) Deliver a consolidated mission report card (PASS/WARN/FAIL/SKIP per leg) and power_budget rollup.
Use subagent delegation freely (infinitely-branching, spawn-depth policy active) to parallelize mechanical vs ECAD vs firmware vs RF workstreams. Autonomy: auto.

deliverables.name: rocket_plane_airframe
deliverables.description: Boost-glide model rocket plane airframe: body, fins, wing, payload bay sized for the flight-computer board.

acceptance_criteria.text: payload bay volume fits flight-computer board envelope

deliverables.name: avionics_integration
deliverables.description: Airframe + flight-computer board integration; no interference; sensor FOV / antenna keepouts respected.

acceptance_criteria.text: no solid interference between board and airframe

deliverables.name: flight_computer_ecad
deliverables.description: Flight-computer E2E: part sourcing, schematic, SPICE OP, PCB place/route/trace-opt, antenna/RF, DRC/DFM/PDN checks.

acceptance_criteria.text: antenna design produced (openEMS or analytic degrade documented)

deliverables.name: firmware_sensor_loop
deliverables.description: STM32F4 firmware project from pinmap, build, Renode sensor-in-the-loop climb_turn_profile scenario.

acceptance_criteria.text: Renode sensor loop PASS or honest SKIP if unprovisioned

deliverables.name: mission_report_card
deliverables.description: Consolidated PASS/WARN/FAIL/SKIP card for all legs + power_budget rollup.

acceptance_criteria.text: report lists every leg with a verdict

assumptions.text: MCU family STM32F4; sensors I2C MPU6050@0x68, BMP280@0x76, LIS3MDL, UART GPS
openEMS/Renode may be absent — degrade with SKIP, never fabricate results

AC2/AC4–AC9 are evidence-graded from named tools (measure_part, ecad_run_drc+erc, ecad_simulate, ecad_antenna_analyze, fw_build, fw_sim_run, report_card). Honest SKIP only with provision-absence evidence (Renode/openEMS/toolchain).

payload.text: payload bay volume fits flight-computer board envelope
no solid interference between board and airframe
antenna design produced (openEMS or analytic degrade documented)
Renode sensor loop PASS or honest SKIP if unprovisioned

manifest.request_verbatim:
Design a model rocket plane (boost-glide airframe) with an integrated central flight computer: MCU (STM32F4-class) + 3V3 buck, MPU6050 IMU, BMP280 baro, LIS3MDL mag, NEO-6M GPS. Full multi-domain mission:
1) PLAN the system (airframe + avionics architecture, interfaces, budgets).
2) PART SOURCING — resolve every IC/connector/fastener via the parts library and/or ecad_find_part; record BOM with provenance.
3) SCHEMATIC — ecad_new_schematic / place / WIRE nets (ecad_connect / net tools) so the netlist has simulatable devices before SPICE.
4) SPICE — ecad_simulate OP on the wired 3V3 front-end; measure V(3V3).
5) PCB LAYOUT + TRACE OPT — REQUIRED chain: board_from_schematic → ecad_optimize_traces → ecad_run_drc (errors==0 or honest FAIL).
6) ANTENNA/RF — ecad_antenna_design + analyze for 2.4 GHz IFA and GPS patch; use openEMS path when provisioned, else document honest degrade/SKIP.
7) FIRMWARE — fw_new_project(stm32f4) + pinmap from netlist + fw_build.
8) RENODE SENSOR-IN-THE-LOOP — climb_turn_profile → fw_sensor_scenario → fw_sim_run + fw_verify_board; SKIP honestly if Renode absent.
9) MECHANICAL — model the rocket-plane airframe as editable CAD with verify_battery PASS: body tube ~OD 40–60mm length ≥300mm, 3–4 fins, wing/glide surface, closed payload bay volume ≥ board envelope; use sketch+extrude/revolve + fillets; avoid zero-thickness and open shells.
10) Deliver a consolidated mission report card (PASS/WARN/FAIL/SKIP per leg) and power_budget rollup.
Use subagent delegation freely (infinitely-branching, spawn-depth policy active) to parallelize mechanical vs ECAD vs firmware vs RF workstreams. Autonomy: auto.
